Joining our team means you will work in a high performing global company where employees collaborate and strive for excellence. Job Description Ensure global materials compliance for electronic products by managing product material data, supplier declarations, analytics, and regulatory submissions; Drive data quality, automation, and decision-making across engineering, sourcing, and quality. Key Responsibilities Manage compliance database - Review, analyse, correct compliance data to maintain the necessary data integrity and validity. Collect, validate, and maintain material compliance data (IPC-1752A/1754, CMRT/EMRT, declarations/certifications, FMDs) from suppliers. Own materials compliance data across product BOMs   Perform gap/risk analysis, prioritise supplier outreach and track closure to targets. Prepare and manage regulatory dossiers and customer responses: EU REACH/SCIP, RoHS, EU Battery Regulation, TSCA, Prop 65, WEEE, Conflict Minerals, and emerging PFAS obligations. Build and maintain dashboards and reports (e.g., Power BI/Tableau) for coverage, risk, and programme KPIs. Integrate compliance checks into change control (PCNs/ECOs) and design-for-compliance reviews. Support internal/external audits and provide training to engineering and sourcing teams. Partner with vendors/platforms (e.g., Assent, BOM check, Silicon Expert, Source Intelligence) to scale coverage and data quality. Qualifications BEng/BSc in Materials/Mechanical/Electrical/Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, or related. 5+ years in product/material compliance in electronics or electro-mechanical manufacturing. Knowledge of EU RoHS, REACH and SCIP, TSCA, Prop 65, WEEE, Conflict Minerals (CMRT/EMRT), PFAS. Proficiency in MS Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Azure Data factory, etc. Proficiency in SQL language, database & management, ecosystems. Proficiency in English. Experience in product BOM and PLM/ERP systems (SAP or Oracle). Experience in MS Power Automate and Power Apps is a plus. Adaptive with strong initiatives, attention-to-detail with a passion for data accuracy, consistency and governance. Automate incident triage, remediation, and postmortems using GenAI-powered tools. Develop intelligent runbooks and self-healing workflows using LLMs. GenAI-Enabled SRE Practices Build and integrate GenAI copilots for on-call support, anomaly detection, and RCA (root cause analysis). Leverage vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate) to retrieve telemetry and incident history for GenAI prompts. CI/CD & Risk Management Integrate GenAI into CI/CD pipelines to generate blast radius analyses and deployment guardrails. Use LLMs to assess the risk of configuration or schema changes before production rollout. Automate validation and rollback strategies based on historical outcomes. full_description: About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled Site Reliability Engineer with experience applying Generative AI (GenAI) to automate and enhance the reliability of complex data platforms. You will be responsible for building self-healing infrastructure, AI-powered observability, and automating incident response across data pipelines (e.g., Databricks, Glue, Kafka, Flink). This is a high-impact role where you will shape the future of data reliability at Techcombank, mentor engineers, and lead initiatives that span multiple teams and domains. Key Responsibilities Platform Reliability & Automation Design, implement, and operate reliable, scalable, and observable data platforms. Automate incident triage, remediation, and postmortems using GenAI-powered tools. Develop intelligent runbooks and self-healing workflows using LLMs. GenAI-Enabled SRE Practices Build and integrate GenAI copilots for on-call support, anomaly detection, and RCA (root cause analysis). Fine-tune or prompt engineer LLMs for specific use cases like summarizing logs, interpreting metrics, or generating remediation steps. Leverage vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate) to retrieve telemetry and incident history for GenAI prompts. Observability & Anomaly Detection Integrate GenAI with observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Build systems for natural language querying of platform health and pipeline performance. Collaborate with data engineers to monitor SLIs/SLOs across ingestion, transformation, and delivery layers. CI/CD & Risk Management Integrate GenAI into CI/CD pipelines to generate blast radius analyses and deployment guardrails. Use LLMs to assess the risk of configuration or schema changes before production rollout. Automate validation and rollback strategies based on historical outcomes. Qualifications Required: 8+ years in SRE, DevOps, or Data Engineering roles with strong focus on automation and observability. Solid experience in cloud-native data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Glue, Kafka, Flink, S3, Lambda). Proven experience using or integrating GenAI tools (OpenAI, Claude, HuggingFace Transformers). Proficiency in Python or Scala; experience with Spark and Airflow a plus. Familiarity with LLM techniques: prompt engineering, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Hands-on experience with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation). Preferred: Experience fine-tuning LLMs or integrating GenAI agents into production systems. Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, FAISS). Knowledge of data quality frameworks and lineage tools (e.g., DeeQu, Great Expectations, Amundsen, Unity Catalog). Understanding of ITIL/incident management frameworks. Strong communication and documentation skills, especially in on-call and postmortem environments.

full_description: [FPT TELECOM] SENIOR IC DESIGN ENGINEER (RTL / DESIGN VERIFICATION)   Shaping the Core of AI Semiconductor Technology | "Make in Vietnam" Locations: Hanoi (onsite) or Ho Chi Minh City (onsite), Vietnam. Level: Senior / Principal Engineer (5+ Years of Experience). Domain: AI SoC (NPU, Smart Camera, IoT Ecosystem).   ROLE OVERVIEW FPT Telecom is pioneering the development of custom AI System-on-Chip (SoC) to power our next-generation Smart Camera and IoT ecosystems. We are seeking core IC Design experts to turn ambitious AI algorithms into silicon reality. In this role, you won't just "design chips" you will be a founding architect of FPT s semiconductor legacy, ensuring first-pass silicon success for our high-performance AI hardware.     DETAILED ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Senior RTL Design Engineer Micro-Architecture: Translate complex AI algorithms (CNN, Transformer) into detailed hardware micro-architecture specifications, optimizing for MAC units and memory hierarchy (Cache/Scratchpad). RTL Coding & Optimization: Develop high-performance logic using SystemVerilog/Verilog, focusing on PPA (Power-Performance-Area) optimization for AI Kernels and High-speed Interconnects. SoC Integration: Integrate complex SoC subsystems including NPUs, ISPs, DDR5/LPDDR4, PCIe, and Network-on-Chip (NoC) fabrics. Design Implementation: Execute Lint, CDC (Clock Domain Crossing), RDC, and initial Logic Synthesis to ensure "routability" and timing-clean handoffs to the Physical Design team. 2. Senior Design Verification (DV) Engineer Verification Strategy: Define comprehensive test plans covering functional specs and critical "corner cases" unique to AI architectures. Advanced UVM Environment: Architect and maintain scalable, constrained-random, OOP-based testbenches using SystemVerilog/UVM from block-level to full-chip. C/C++ Modeling: Collaborate on building Golden Reference Models in C/C++/SystemC to validate RTL data integrity and algorithmic accuracy. Coverage & Performance Closure: Drive Functional and Code Coverage to 100%. Perform Performance Verification to ensure the chip meets target TOPS (Tera Operations Per Second). Post-Synthesis Verification: Execute Gate-Level Simulation (GLS) to verify timing and reset behaviors post-synthesis.     CORE REQUIREMENTS Experience: Minimum 5+ years of proven experience in Front-end IC Design/Verification. Must have participated in at least one successful Tape-out project. full_description: General Purpose JOB DESCRIPTION Corsair Gaming is seeking a Product Engineering/Supplier Quality Engineering (PE/SQE) Manager to oversee the development, qualification, and production of high-performance gaming peripherals and components. This role will be based in Vietnam and will focus on ensuring product quality, supplier compliance, and continuous improvement in collaboration with ODM/OEM partners and internal cross-functional teams. Position Summary, Responsibilities And Expectations Product Engineering & Development Oversee new product introduction (NPI) and sustaining engineering activities in collaboration with global engineering teams. Act as the primary technical interface between Corsair and ODM/OEM partners in Vietnam, ensuring design for manufacturability (DFM) and quality. Work closely with R&D, Industrial Design, and Validation teams to ensure a seamless transition from design to mass production. Supplier Quality Management Own the supplier quality engineering (SQE) function for gaming peripherals, ensuring strict adherence to Corsair s quality standards, specifications, and reliability requirements. Conduct supplier audits, process capability analysis, and failure mode & effects analysis (FMEA) to identify and mitigate risks. Implement statistical process control (SPC) and quality control plans to monitor and improve supplier performance. Ensure compliance with industry regulations such as ISO 9001, RoHS, REACH, and environmental sustainability initiatives. Manufacturing & Process Improvement Collaborate with suppliers to optimize yield, reduce defects, and enhance production efficiency. Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) efforts for supplier-related quality issues. Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies. Develop and enforce incoming quality control (IQC), in-process quality control (IPQC), and outgoing quality control (OQC) strategies. Cross-functional Collaboration & Reporting Serve as the bridge between global Product Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to align quality expectations and resolve technical challenges. Provide regular updates on supplier performance, yield, and product quality metrics to executive leadership. Train and mentor suppliers and factory teams on Corsair s quality systems and best practices. Essential Skills And Experience Bachelor s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, or related field).
